cases.name: aead_nonce_sender_domain_collision
assertions: sender_nonce_prefix derives from the canonical key_ref/epoch/device_id/purpose/aead_profile Context
two active sender devices under the same key_ref/epoch/purpose derive distinct prefixes
a nonce whose prefix does not match the declared sender device fails with aead_nonce_sender_domain_collision

cases.name: aead_nonce_counter_replay
assertions: device_nonce_counter_be64 is parsed from the last 8 nonce bytes
the first counter use in a sender scope is accepted
a repeated counter in the same sender scope fails with aead_nonce_counter_replay

cases.name: aead_nonce_random_rejected
assertions: AES-GCM nonce length still uses deterministic prefix plus 8-byte counter
a pure random 96-bit nonce does not equal the canonical derivation
random nonce fallback fails with aead_nonce_derivation_invalid
